name: random-field Ising antiferromagnetic chain
question: Does an antiferromagnetic chain return to its configuration at a turning point, although every loop through the field is frustrated?
assumptions: A periodic chain of 256 elements with two states and antiferromagnetic nearest-neighbour couplings
Gaussian random local fields of width 2 in units of the coupling
A uniform field, changed slowly from a large negative value; thermal activation is neglected

provenance.source: J. M. Deutsch, A. Dhar and O. Narayan, Phys. Rev. Lett. 92, 227203 (2004)
